opencode.label: OpenCode Zen
opencode.description: Curated AI models tested by the OpenCode team. Free tier: 100 requests/day; free models cost $0, paid models are per-token.

privatemodeai.label: PrivateMode AI
privatemodeai.description: Confidential AI inference — prompts are hardware-encrypted in transit and at rest. Free: 5M tokens on signup, then 1M prompt + 1M completion tokens/month.

nvidia.label: NVIDIA
nvidia.description: Hosted open models (Llama, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen) on NVIDIA NIM. Free credits for new accounts; ~40 requests/min.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter
openrouter.description: One API for 400+ models from every major vendor. ':free' model variants share a free pool (~50 requests/day); paid models use credits.

cloudflare.label: Cloudflare Workers AI
cloudflare.description: Llama, Kimi and Qwen on Cloudflare's edge network. Free daily neuron allocation; needs an API token + Account ID.

groq.label: Groq
groq.description: Ultra-fast LPU inference of Llama, Kimi, Qwen and more. Generous free tier with per-model daily request limits.

together.label: Together AI
together.description: Hosted open-source models (Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen). Free trial credits on signup, then pay-as-you-go.

mistral.label: Mistral
mistral.description: Mistral's own models (Large, Small, Codestral). Free experiment tier with monthly token limits; paid plans scale up.

anthropic.label: Anthropic
anthropic.description: Claude models (Sonnet, Opus, Haiku). Pay-as-you-go per token; requires billing enabled.

openai.label: OpenAI
openai.description: GPT-5, o-series and GPT-4o. Pay-as-you-go per token; no standing free tier.

deepseek.label: DeepSeek
deepseek.description: DeepSeek V3 and R1 (chat + reasoning). Very low per-token pricing; no free tier.
